d:
Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ki or se sanpann logon se svechchha se mupht bijli ka labh chhorne ki apil par mujaphpharpur ke logon ne narajgi jataee hai. logon ka kahna hai ki agar sarkar chahti hai ki sanpann log sarkari suvidhaon ka labh chhoren, to iski shuruaat pahle netaon aur adhikariyon se honi chahie.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
